programs.title: The Shadow of an Empire Ep.5
programs.desc: Visit the Eastern Qing Tombs at the foot of Changrui Mountain in Zunhua, Hebei, the burial site of China's last imperial dynasty. Resting here are the Emperors Shunzhi and Kangxi, as well as the Empress Dowager Cixi and other Qing royalty. Through these tombs, the documentary brings to life the former glory and fading echoes of the Great Qing Empire.

programs.title: Resurrection of Ancient Books Ep.1
programs.desc: Meet a group of \"doctors\" who specialize in ancient book restoration. Watch their heroic rescue efforts as they repair these national treasures with surgical precision, preserving their precious histories for all time.

programs.title: Timeless Ancient Structures The Temple of Heaven
programs.desc: Built on the southern end of Beijing's Central Axis, the Temple of Heaven has endured over the course of the last 600 years. Also a UNESCO World Heritage Site, it is described as a masterpiece of architecture and landscape design, and is a must-see attraction for domestic and foreign tourists alike. Join us as we explore its fascinating history and the significance of all the wonders it beholds.

programs.title: Music from the Murals: Dunhuang Musical Instruments Ep.2
programs.desc: Research and restoration showcase performance styles depicted in the Dunhuang murals, reconstructing the shapes of ancient instruments and highlighting the Silk Road music heritage.
